summary.en: Mankind discloses a small named discovery pipeline in metabolic and autoimmune diseases alongside its broader pharmaceutical business. The verified clinical assets are MKP10241 and MKP11093.
summary.zh: Mankind披露了代谢和自身免疫疾病领域一条规模较小的已命名发现管线，同时拥有更广泛的制药业务。已核实的临床资产为MKP10241和MKP11093。

ind.en: Rheumatoid arthritis; ulcerative colitis, plaque psoriasis and alopecia
ind.zh: 类风湿关节炎；溃疡性结肠炎、斑块状银屑病和脱发

watch.en: In-licensing and selective brand acquisitions support the strategy to expand chronic therapies.
watch.zh: 通过授权引进和选择性品牌收购支持扩大慢性病治疗领域的战略。

watch.en: MKP11093 received Indian government PRIP funding, according to the October 2026 call.
watch.zh: 据2026年10月电话会议称，MKP11093获得印度政府PRIP资助。

watch.en: Chronic therapies excluding BSV reached 37.4% of the business in Q2 FY27.
watch.zh: 不含BSV的慢性病治疗在2027财年第二季度占业务的37.4%。

gaps: No company-wide phase counts or dated next asset milestones verified; counts and next are null.
Only two named clinical discovery candidates were verified; unnamed oncology, immuno-oncology and MASH research was not converted into assets.
MKP10241's molecular target was not established in the current company discovery pipeline; null.

MKP11093 Phase 1 refers to CDSCO trial authorization in September 2025, before June 2026; subsequent trial initiation or phase progression was not established. The October 2026 call gives no new phase or dated clinical milestone.
